# PR smoke set: the files `ci.yml`'s `test` job runs on every PR. One path per line; `#` lines are skipped.
# Goal: "no major functionality is broken" in 5-10 minutes. Core = the merge/gate engine (test_work) and the loop
# (test_loop); the rest are fast guards of CI itself and the shared plumbing.
# Measured 2026-10-16 on a developer Mac, 3 workers (a GitHub macOS runner has 3 cores), another job running on
# the same machine: these files total about 615 test-seconds, ~4 minutes of wall time; the non-pytest gates add
# ~11 s. NOT yet measured on a GitHub runner: the first PR run reports it.
# Left to the nightly run: test_doctor (383 test-seconds), test_phase_record_gate, test_phase_report, test_init_flow.
